answer: A nebula of cheap identities collapses when each agent must lock a refundable work bond tied to one hardware-backed key, and a rotating spot-check forces a random slice of agents to redo a fresh task live within minutes. Like water carving karst, repeated live checks erode fakes: an identity that cannot answer in time loses its bond, and saffron-priced bonds make ten thousand fakes cost ten thousand deposits while one honest agent pays once.
